rrf.ranks: tie-aware (equal scores share the best rank)
rrf.selection: mean official composite on the 4 training folds; first in (model, k) order wins ties

rerank.candidates: each query's baseline top 50 (its fold's config)
rerank.product_text: title. Brand: brand. Category: category_path. description
rerank.score: pure cross-encoder reorder of the top 50, stable; ranks 51+ unchanged

meta.combination: run only if both pass alone; RRF per-fold config chosen by RRF composite, its top 50 reranked
meta.keep_rule: official composite 95% paired-bootstrap interval vs baseline above 0; fail with judged-only mean diff > 0 is inconclusive; neither passes -> final is the baseline

shipped_path_check.result: HybridRanker.rank top 30 identical to the cached path

latency_ms.method: HybridRanker.rank(top_k=30), warm, configs interleaved per query
